Name: Bee Farmer Mod
Author: SirBeedle
Description:
I added two different styles of antennae, each one linked to a gender group of hairstyles. The male hairstyles get somewhat straight antennae while the females receive curly ones.

For shirts I replaced the red white jersey with a brown yellow variant, and the white top with a heart with a yellow top with a brown heart.

To add these files to the game, simply download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Pathoschild's Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and unzip the mod folder into [code]﻿[/code][code]Stardew Valley/mods 
[/code]
